purpose: Original detailed deck and below-deck reconstruction for the existing ordinary POTC family and both paint variants.

stock_contract.claim: Existing pinned stock-derived identity and total count only; no game interior coordinates known.

method: Museum and primary-plan catalogue research supplies arrangement vocabulary. All metre dimensions, room positions and access clearances are authored to the preserved hull. Public source text is paraphrased; no museum image, plan tracing or proprietary texture is distributed.

sources.title: Royal Museums Greenwich: Gannet (1800), ZAZ4365
sources.observed: The catalogue identifies a 1:48 drawing of the upper deck, lower deck and hold of the 16-gun brig-sloop Gannet, initialled by Surveyor John Henslow.
sources.application: Separate main battery, lower berth/storage deck and hold, accessed by physical companion openings; compact after accommodation.
sources.limit: Sixteen-gun historical analogue, not the 24-gun game Brig; exact gun positions, dimensions and internal partitions are authored.
sources.applies_to: Separate main battery, lower berth/storage deck and hold, accessed by physical companion openings; compact after accommodation.

sources.title: Royal Museums Greenwich: deck plan of Cruizer (1797)
sources.observed: A museum-held deck plan exists for the later brig-sloop Cruizer.
sources.application: Late two-masted brig arrangement vocabulary and a clear working deck.
sources.limit: No museum plan image is copied; later brig analogue is not evidence of POTC retail geometry or a Snow mast.
sources.applies_to: Late two-masted brig arrangement vocabulary and a clear working deck.

decisions.basis: One continuous 24-gun main battery, separate berth deck, framed hold and a furnished cabin on the lower after deck. The low preserved quarterdeck does not falsely promise a full standing room above the main gun deck. No Snow/trysail pole. This is an authored adaptation of the listed historical analogues to the unchanged game-family gun total.

decisions.feature: Physically separate lower levels and hold
decisions.basis: The authored hull contains distinct berth_lower and a framed hold. Numerical deck and floor baselines are fitted estimates; the source deck hierarchy supplies arrangement vocabulary rather than retail game coordinates.

decisions.feature: After cabin and unobstructed structural access
decisions.basis: The furnished after cabin has a real centered partition door opening from its own lower deck. The main hatch shaft reaches that level; no side stair crosses a cabin wall or opens into a sealed low quarterdeck space. Cabin dimensions and this access route are authored game-environment choices.

coordinate_system.longitudinal: s_fraction of preserved deck length, positive forward
coordinate_system.absolute_plan: x_m across ship, y_m up, forward_z_m positive bow
coordinate_system.note: Vertical z_m fields follow the existing Blender builder convention; longitudinal at/from/to are fractions.
